plan: 1. Select the magenta swatch at its visible center. 2. Draw a magenta stroke inside the canvas. 3. Select the dark-blue swatch. 4. Draw a dark-blue stroke inside the canvas. 5. Tap Submit and verify success. ```json {"action":"click","coordinate":[384,270]} ```
